title: Grateful Dead Live at San Jose State University on 1969-10-31
lineage: SBD > MC > C1> DAT> CDR > SHN

ai_review.summary: Raw, hiss‑laden soundboard capture of a historic Halloween 1969 show featuring the only Cryptical > China Cat Sunflower segue, with a solid performance that shines despite poor audio.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source plagued by noticeable hiss and low‑fidelity tape noise, making it a rough listen. Musically, the show is praised for strong renditions of Dire Wolf, Cryptical Suite, Rider, Hell and especially the unique Cryptical reprise into China Cat Sunflower – a one‑off moment that gives the performance historic weight.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews average ~3.25 stars; reviewers love the show (especially the rare song combo) but consistently criticize the recording quality, leading to a middling overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Prominent hiss and raw tape noise; overall mix is audible but details are muddy, making listening effortful.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows with a rare Cryptical reprise into China Cat Sunflower and solid mid‑set numbers, typical of the late‑60s Dead repertoire, delivering a fun and energetic experience despite audio flaws.
